name: 진시황
linesEn: Commandery system · Standardized measures · Unified script
epithet: 여섯 나라를 무너뜨리고 첫 황제라 칭한 뒤, 만세에 전하라 명하고 이세에서 끝난 창업자
epithetEn: The founder who toppled six states, named himself the first emperor, decreed the line would run ten thousand generations, and ended at the second

name: 이사
linesEn: Petition Against Expelling Guests · Proposed the commandery system · Proposed the book burning
The Shaqiu conspiracy · Cut in two at the Xianyang market
epithet: 사람의 잘나고 못남은 쥐가 어디 있느냐에 달렸다고 말한 뒤, 곳간에 올라 제국의 법을 쓰고 그 법에 죽은 승상
epithetEn: The chancellor who said a man's worth is decided by where the rat stands, climbed into the granary, wrote the empire's law, and died by it

name: 조고
lines: 사구의 조서 · 이사 처형 · 사슴을 말이라 부른 자리
linesEn: Acting Keeper of Seals · Held the imperial seal
The Shaqiu edict · The execution of Li Si · The deer called a horse
epithet: 힘이 세고 옥법에 밝다는 이유로 뽑혀 옥새를 맡은 자리에서 이십 년을 버틴 끝에, 봉해진 글 하나로 제국의 후계를 바꾼 실무자
epithetEn: Chosen for his strength and his command of penal law, he kept the seal for twenty years and changed the succession of an empire with a single sealed letter

name: 부소
lines: 함양의 매장 뒤 간언 · 상군에서 몽염의 군을 감독
linesEn: Eldest son of the First Emperor
Remonstrated after the burials at Xianyang · Oversaw Meng Tian's army at Shang commandery
Took his own life on a forged edict
epithet: 아버지의 법에 한 번 간언했다가 변방으로 보내진 뒤, 아버지의 이름이 적힌 가짜 문서를 받고 묻지 않은 채 죽은 장남
epithetEn: The eldest son who remonstrated once against his father's law, was sent to the frontier, received a forged letter bearing his father's name, and died without asking
